note: NECO Commerce round 2 (Round 18 lift): retail types (itinerant traders, supermarket, department store, chain stores, mail order), wholesale steadiness, documents new to the bank (invoice, receipt, proforma, debit note, statement of account, indent, letter of credit, bill of entry), banking (overdraft, bank draft, fixed deposit, exchange rate, inflation), insurance (compulsory third-party, premium, reinsurance, actuary), units (prospectus, consumer cooperative, merger), scope (distribution, manufacturing, extractive), tourism, advertising (reminder, competitive, agencies), trade (FOB, CIF, invisible exports), private warehouse, grain silos. Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the large JAMB Commerce banks.
